- Checking products for quality and any defects.
- Refilling packaging materials and production supplies.
- Keeping your work area clean and safe.

- Afternoon Shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
- Night Shift: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM

   Wat we je bieden - Gross monthly salary starting from €3,150, including shift allowance (based on a full-time workweek).

- Working for an internationally recognised food manufacturer.
- Employee discount on Intersnack products.
- Informal working environment with supportive colleagues.
- Opportunity to gain valuable experience in the food production industry.

At Start People, we reward based on the principle of equal pay; your terms of employment always align with those of colleagues directly employed by the client. - Are physically fit and able to perform manual work.
- Speak English or Dutch.
- Work accurately and follow safety procedures.
- Experience in production is an advantage, but not required.

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

SamenvattingJoin our friendly and fast-growing team as a Warehouse Worker, where you’ll enjoy stable shifts, a clean and safe working environment, and the opportunity to play an important role in delivering high-quality food products while growing your career. Good work!Over de functieAs a Warehouse Worker, you will play an important role in ensuring smooth and efficient work flow in a dynamic environment, with stable day shifts and future opportunities to grow into a three-shift system.
Your responsibilities:
- You manually move products from point A to point B
- You assist in preparing shipments and receiving products
- Solve minor technical issues
- Perform light administrative tasks

Working hours:
You will work from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system consisting of a morning shift and an afternoon shift.

With expertise in grinding, mixing, sifting, and repackaging, GECO provides flexible, high-quality solutions for its clients. The company holds a BRC certification, ensuring the highest food safety and quality standards, and its reliable service makes it a trusted partner for both small and large food businesses.
Wat wij vragen- Private accommodation
- Good command of English
- Ability to set priorities and work efficiently
- Comfortable working both independently and in a team

These qualities are important for the Warehouse Worker role in Someren. But we also want to get to know you - we’d love to hear about your talents, experience, and ideas. Surprise us!
Wat wij bieden- Full-time, stable and a long-term work!
- Monthly salary gross €2600
- Shift allowance for afternoon shifts: 110% of the base salary
- Shift allowance for night shifts: 120% of the base salary

Samenvatting\Step into a dynamic role as a Production Operator A and be at the heart of our production, where your skills keep everything running smoothly and contribute directly to delivering fresh, high-quality products every day. Good work!Over de functieThe Operator A is responsible for ensuring that the assigned production line operates efficiently, producing products that meet both quality and quantity standards. This role involves performing basic production tasks while strictly adhering to safety and quality regulations.
Your key Responsibilities:
- Set up and monitor machines and automated processes
- Track production, manage orders, and make adjustments
- Perform quality checks, including metal detection, and report issues
- Maintain order and safety on the line
- Guide and supervise line staff to ensure compliance
- Escalate any deviations

Working hours:
- Our warehouses operate 24/7, so the work schedule includes weekend shifts as well as morning, afternoon, and night shifts.

Shift start times vary depending on the shift and the team. For example, a morning shift may start at 06:00, 08:00, or 10:00.
Over het bedrijfHessing Greenport began as a small family business in 1968 and has since grown into a European leader in fresh vegetables. Operating in 5 countries, we proudly supply top retailers, wholesalers, and hospitality brands with premium quality produce. With a 33% market share in the Netherlands and partnerships with names like Jumbo and Superunie, we set the standard for freshness and innovation. Join us and be part of a team where every day is about excellence, growth, and making a real impact in the food industry!
Wat wij vragen- MBO level 2 work and thinking skills, with relevant experience in a similar role
- Experience in the food production industry, quality standards (HACCP, BRC)
- Ability to operate and monitor machinery, handle production data, and perform quality checks
- Good proficiency in Dutch and/or English language

Are you passionate about sports and looking for an exciting career in logistics? Join our dynamic team at Decathlon's ultra-modern warehouse in Tilburg! We're seeking enthusiastic individuals to help manage our international distribution center, serving stores and customers across multiple European countries.

Your role in our team
As a Logistics Employee at Decathlon, you'll be part of a dedicated team responsible for ensuring smooth operations in our state-of-the-art facility. Your main duties will include:

- Processing orders efficiently using advanced robotic systems

- Collaborating with team members to meet daily goals and targets

- Maintaining high standards of accuracy and safety in all operational processes

- Opportunity to develop into specialized roles such as 'captain' or 'trainer'

What we offer
At Decathlon, we value our employees and offer a range of benefits to support your growth and well-being:

- Competitive starting salary of €2338.27 per month (38-hour week), with potential for monthly bonuses

- 8% holiday pay and 24 vacation days

- 20% discount on Decathlon products

- Comprehensive training and development opportunities

- Employee share ownership program

- Travel expense reimbursement (100% for bike/public transport, 50% for car up to 30km)

- Access to sports coaching and wellness platforms

- Regular team events and outings

What we're looking for
The ideal candidate for this role will possess:

- A passion for sports and an active lifestyle

- Flexibility to work 32-38 hours per week, including one weekend day

- Availability for various shifts (morning, afternoon/evening, night)

- Excellent command of English

- Valid Dutch passport/visa/work permit

- Residence within a 30-minute radius of our Tilburg warehouse

- Alignment with our core values: vitality, generosity, responsibility, and authenticity

About Decathlon
Decathlon is a global leader in sporting goods retail, committed to making sports accessible to all.

As a production team leader, you will join a large Dutch fruit and vegetable processing company. The company works with modern production lines and actively invests in employee development. You will have the opportunity to grow within a stable organisation where quality, teamwork and continuous improvement are key. 
As a production team leader, you lead a production team every day and make sure production runs safely, efficiently and to a high standard. You will work with modern production lines, have plenty of opportunities to develop yourself and earn an attractive gross monthly salary between €3,000 and €3,600, excluding allowances. 
About the function 
This is what your day looks like as a production team leader: you start with a walk around the department. You check how the line is running, whether the machines are ready and if there are any updates from the previous shift. With a coffee in hand, you discuss the planning with your team: who works where, what is today's output target and what needs extra attention? While production is running, you keep an overview. You coach your colleagues, make adjustments where needed and ensure quality and safety always come first. As a production team leader, your working hours may vary depending on the season. 
What we need - You have MBO level of working and thinking - You speak Dutch and/or English - You have several years of proven experience in a production environment - You do not mind working in a cold and wet environment - You take responsibility, communicate clearly and keep a good overview
